sections.title: Usage
items: The result of the currently focused input box is output in the result box at the bottom of the window
To add another input box, press enter
To remove an input box, press backspace when the box is empty
Input boxes can be easily navigated using the up and down arrow keys
The workspace can be used for writing Diorite code which you can save or load using the buttons

sections.title: Values
items: Numbers (e.g., 100 or 0.5), and complex numbers (e.g., a + ib)
Variables defined in the format [a-Z] on their own or followed by a subscript number, e.g., x or x0
infinity or inf
undefined

sections.title: Constants
items: pi
tau
euler

sections.title: Sets
items: Natural: N
Integer: Z
Rational: Q
Irrational: I
Real: R
Complex: C

sections.title: Notation
items: All statements must be closed by a semi-colon (;)
Whitespace is ignored
Multiplication must explicitly include the multiplication symbol and not be shorthand, e.g., a * b not ab
Functions must be of the form [a-Z](x) and can include an optional set hint, e.g., f(x : N) = 2 * x
There are various general-purpose library functions that can be used, including abs, sign, sum, floor, ceil, gcd, lcm, and sqrt
There are various trigonometric library functions that can be used, including deg, rad, sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, and atan
